title: 陆克文：中国技术产业战略以出口为支柱，印度能否竞争？
speaker: Kevin Rudd

segments.en: Let me look carefully at the Chinese industrial model or techno-industrial strategy which comes from the top in terms of top level design in the Chinese system.
segments.zh: 让我仔细审视中国的工业模式或技术产业战略，它来自中国体系顶层的顶层设计。

segments.en: This is a conscious strategy by the Chinese party state in order to place China's techno-industrial dominance at the absolute centre of its strategy not just made in China 2025 what is replaced at how do you actually achieve dominance across the technology stack including the AI stack.
segments.zh: 这是中国党国体系的一项自觉战略，旨在将中国的技术产业主导地位置于其战略的绝对中心，不仅仅是“中国制造2025”，而是如何真正在包括AI在内的技术栈中实现主导。

segments.en: So this has to be funded from somewhere and so it's funded by the Chinese system writ large and if the alternative is putting that investment into a proper social security safety net in China the Chinese leadership that I know will go for the first, rather than the second any day of the week.
segments.zh: 所以这必须有资金支持，因此由整个中国体系提供资金。如果替代方案是将这些投入用于中国完善的社会保障安全网，我所认识的中国领导层任何时候都会选择前者，而非后者。

segments.en: Real quickly we heard from the Foreign Minister of India talking about the India-China relationship and this trade deficit that it still has. Is there anything to address that I mean when you talk about India and really kind of push for this industrial policy it seems to have struggled we've heard maybe now some news on Apple who have been manufacturing here.
segments.zh: 快速问一下，我们听到印度外长谈到印中关系和仍然存在的贸易逆差。有什么办法解决吗？我的意思是，当谈到印度并真正推动这一产业政策时，它似乎遇到了困难，我们可能听到了一些关于苹果在这里制造的消息。

segments.en: Well you're right to say that the trade deficit is ballooning to China. Underbillion. Yeah. To China's advantage and against India and this is a wider reflection of the export dependent model I referred to before.
segments.zh: 你说得对，对华贸易逆差正在膨胀。是的。对中国有利，对印度不利，这更广泛地反映了我之前提到的出口依赖模式。

segments.en: We haven't even mentioned Southeast Asia which is now the largest destination for Chinese exports in the world followed by Europe, followed by the United States, followed by India. That's basically the big four. So these are the four pillars of China's net export $1.2 trillion US earnings from the world.
segments.zh: 我们甚至还没提到东南亚，它现在是中国出口的最大目的地，其次是欧洲，再次是美国，然后是印度。这基本上就是四大。所以这些是中国1.2万亿美元净出口收入的四大支柱。
